description: Autonomous experiment-loop evals for Contextro benchmark work. Covers correct triggering, benchmark selection, baseline discipline, keep/discard rigor, and guardrail preservation.

benchmark_commands.bench: cd crates && cargo run --release -p contextro --bin contextro-bench -- <repo-path>
benchmark_commands.study: cd crates && cargo run --release -p contextro --bin contextro-study -- --codebase <repo-path> --output-dir <dir> --tasks 200
benchmark_commands.indexing: cd crates && cargo test --quiet -p contextro-indexing --test bench_index -- --nocapture

evals.name: trigger-cold-index-breakthrough
evals.prompt: Run autoresearch on Contextro and keep iterating until cold index latency breaks 25ms without hurting tool correctness.
evals.expected_behavior: Skill loads, chooses contextro-bench as the primary harness, names the cold-index metric and a sub-25ms breakthrough target, and establishes the retained ~32ms baseline before edits.

evals.name: trigger-token-breakthrough
evals.prompt: Keep improving the retained 200-task Contextro repo study until we beat 6,244 total tokens without dropping below 100% success.
evals.expected_behavior: Skill loads, chooses contextro-study as the primary harness, keeps 100% success as a hard guardrail, and treats 6,244 tokens as the retained baseline to beat.

evals.name: baseline-discipline-indexing
evals.prompt: Experiment on the indexing pipeline and find a real win, not a benchmark illusion.
evals.expected_behavior: Skill loads, reads retained results first, uses bench_index for localized signal and contextro-bench for confirmation, and does not start editing before a reproducible baseline exists.

evals.name: keep-or-discard-guardrails
evals.prompt: We found a change that cuts study tokens a bit, but success fell to 99.5%. Decide whether to keep it and continue.
evals.expected_behavior: Skill loads and discards or reverts the change because success dropped below the retained 100% guardrail.

evals.name: non-trigger-explain-benchmark
evals.prompt: Explain what contextro-study measures and how it differs from contextro-bench.
evals.expected_behavior: Skill does not load because the user asked for explanation, not an autonomous experiment loop.

evals.name: non-trigger-single-bug-fix
evals.prompt: Fix this one Rust compile error in crates/contextro-tools/src/search.rs.
evals.expected_behavior: Skill does not load because the request is a direct code fix, not a benchmark loop.
